title: Spring Fettuccine with Zesty Croation Cream Sauce
description: A French-inspired pasta dish featuring the flavors of Croatia, with zesty cream sauce and fresh spring herbs.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fettuccine pasta according to package instructions.
In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the zesty Croatian cream and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let sauce simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the grated Parmesan cheese until melted.
Add the thinly sliced spring onions to the sauce and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Drain the cooked fettuccine pasta and add it to the saucepan with the zesty Croatian cream sauce.
Toss the pasta in the sauce until well coated.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
